panels.description: ICMP loss to a device inside the room, so the measured path includes that room's access port. Other probes on this dashboard terminate at S0 or earlier.
panels.title: Packet loss by room

panels.description: 99th percentile RTT to the same room devices. The responder is a consumer AP or router whose CPU adds its own delay, so compare a room against its own baseline rather than against other rooms.

targets.expr: sum by (key) (label_join(sum by (site,room) (1000 * histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le,site,room) (rate(smokeping_response_duration_seconds_bucket{job="smokeping",room!=""}[$__rate_interval])))), "key", " room ", "site", "room"))

panels.title: Latency p99 by room

panels.description: End-to-end probe loss beside the switch's egress discard ratio for the same port. R6S3 and R6S4 do not implement the discard counter and return 0.00% on every port; read 0 there as not measured. Limited to rooms that have a probe.

targets.expr: sum by (key) (label_join(sum by (site,room) (1000 * histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le,site,room) (rate(smokeping_response_duration_seconds_bucket{job="smokeping",room!=""}[$__rate_interval])))), "key", " room ", "site", "room"))

(sum by (key, switch_name) (label_join(sum by (site,room,switch_name) (100 * label_replace(rate(ifOutDiscards{job="network_switches",ifAlias=~"room[0-9]+[a-z]?"}[$__rate_interval]),"room","$1","ifAlias","room0*([0-9]+)[a-z]?")) / sum by (site,room,switch_name) (label_replace(rate(ifHCOutUcastPkts{job="network_switches",ifAlias=~"room[0-9]+[a-z]?"}[$__rate_interval]),"room","$1","ifAlias","room0*([0-9]+)[a-z]?") + label_replace(rate(ifOutDiscards{job="network_switches",ifAlias=~"room[0-9]+[a-z]?"}[$__rate_interval]),"room","$1","ifAlias","room0*([0-9]+)[a-z]?")), "key", " room ", "site", "room"))) and on(key) (sum by (key) (label_join(sum by (site,room) (smokeping_requests_total{job="smokeping",room!=""}), "key", " room ", "site", "room")))

(sum by (key) (label_join(sum by (site,room) (8 * label_replace(rate(ifHCOutOctets{job="network_switches",ifAlias=~"room[0-9]+[a-z]?"}[$__rate_interval]),"room","$1","ifAlias","room0*([0-9]+)[a-z]?") / 1e6), "key", " room ", "site", "room"))) and on(key) (sum by (key) (label_join(sum by (site,room) (smokeping_requests_total{job="smokeping",room!=""}), "key", " room ", "site", "room")))

panels.title: Room loss: probe vs switch counter

panels.description: Egress discards per unicast packet sent toward the room, counting only ports above 10 pkt/s. Without that floor an idle port with 0.3 discards/s ranks as '30%'.
panels.title: Top egress drop ratio to rooms (discards per packet sent)

panels.description: Probes sent vs replies received. Targets probed at less than 0.1/s are excluded so a newly added or removed rung does not read as 100% loss while its window fills.
panels.title: Packet loss by target

panels.description: Spread between the 99th and 50th percentile round-trip. A target can show zero loss and still be unusable if this is large.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, host, site) (rate(smokeping_response_duration_seconds_bucket{job="smokeping",room=""}[5m]))) - histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, host, site) (rate(smokeping_response_duration_seconds_bucket{job="smokeping",room=""}[5m])))

panels.title: Jitter (p99 - p50)

panels.description: Discards per inbound unicast packet, counting only ports carrying >10 pkt/s. Without that floor an idle port with 0.3 discards/s ranks as '30%'.
panels.title: Top drop ratio (discards per packet)

panels.description: Only the v4.0 units populate dot3StatsTable, so this covers 4 of 12 switches and none of the known bad ports. Empty means no active FCS errors on those four.

defaults.noValue: No active FCS errors on the four switches that report dot3StatsTable (the v4.0 units). The other eight do not expose this counter at all.

panels.title: FCS errors - bad cable, SFP or EMI

panels.description: dot3StatsLateCollisions reads zero on every switch in this fleet, so this panel cannot detect a duplex mismatch here. Kept only so the gap is visible.

defaults.noValue: dot3StatsLateCollisions reads zero on every switch in this fleet, so this panel cannot detect a duplex mismatch here.

panels.title: Late collisions - duplex mismatch

panels.description: Only the v4.0 units populate dot3StatsTable. Historical symbol errors exist on R6S3/R6S4 but are not currently incrementing.

defaults.noValue: No active symbol errors on the four switches that report dot3StatsTable (the v4.0 units). The other eight do not expose this counter at all.

panels.title: Symbol errors - failing transceiver

panels.description: Egress bits/s against negotiated link speed. Ports with no link are excluded - dividing by a clamped zero turned 344 down ports into six-figure percentages.
panels.title: Trunk utilisation vs link speed

panels.description: Inbound broadcast frames per second. Broadcast is flooded to every port and handled by the switch CPU.
panels.title: Broadcast received per switch

panels.description: Inbound multicast frames per second. Unregistered multicast is flooded like broadcast unless IGMP snooping is enabled.
panels.title: Multicast received per switch

panels.description: Five-minute CPU average, one series per switch.
panels.title: Switch CPU (5m)

panels.description: Number of ifLastChange transitions in the window. A port changing state repeatedly means an unstable link on that port.
panels.title: Port flaps (state changes, 6h)

panels.description: Flooded frames as a fraction of all inbound frames.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (site, switch_name) (rate(ifHCInBroadcastPkts{job="network_switches"}[15m]) + rate(ifHCInMulticastPkts{job="network_switches"}[15m])) / sum by (site, switch_name) (rate(ifHCInBroadcastPkts{job="network_switches"}[15m]) + rate(ifHCInMulticastPkts{job="network_switches"}[15m]) + rate(ifHCInUcastPkts{job="network_switches"}[15m])))

panels.title: Broadcast+multicast share of inbound packets

panels.description: ifInUnknownProtos: frames discarded because the protocol is not supported.
panels.title: Unknown-protocol drops

panels.description: Hardware revision, firmware build, CPU and memory for each switch.
panels.title: Switch revision, CPU and memory

panels.description: Five-minute CPU average. One series per switch, with the hardware revision shown in the legend label; values are not aggregated by revision.
panels.title: Switch CPU (5m), revision in legend

panels.description: 99th-percentile ICMP round-trip to each switch's own management address, one series per switch with the revision in the legend label. This address is answered by the switch CPU and is not the path user traffic takes through the switch.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, host) (rate(smokeping_response_duration_seconds_bucket{job="smokeping"}[10m]))) * on(host) group_left(switch_name, tpSysHardwareVersion) label_replace(tpSysHardwareVersion{job="network_switches"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "(.*)")

panels.title: Switch ping p99, revision in legend
